settings.fallback_description: High-concentration Extrait de Parfum releases exploring shadow, dense natural resins, and unhurried maceration. Bottled in subtly smoked 50 ml glass and issued in numbered batches of 50 flacons.

settings.heading: SCARCITY THROUGH MACERATION.
settings.body: Reserve Editions are never rushed to meet seasonal calendars. Each 50-flacon release reflects extended oil maceration and individual batch numbering.

settings.heading: DISCOVER THE PERMANENT ARCHIVE
settings.body: Return to our four foundational 20% Eau de Parfum compositions exploring cool limestone, crushed fig leaf, Japanese hinoki, and green cardamom.
